get.summary: Corporate actions applied to a wallet, newest first: type, treatment, lifecycle state, evidence and validation status

kind.description: mainnet: real chain history. synthetic: generated demo data on a local network

treatment.description: income: units added are income. quantity_basis: units rescaled, basis spread across them. basis_allocation: units added are principal bought with distributed value. identity: same position in a new underlying form. not_booked: recognised, not booked; conversion disabled

status.description: validated: confirmed against real recorded instances. unvalidated: no real instance has confirmed it; never booked. not_built: recognised only

quantity.description: Units added (negative: removed). Zero for an ordinary split

factor.description: New units per old unit, for splits, stock dividends and identity changes

distributedFraction.description: Share of the position's value delivered by a spin-off or rights distribution: (M_new − M_old) ÷ M_new

usd.description: Income value; only for income. Null means unknown, never zero

proceedsUsd.description: Issuer proceeds for a distribution, when published and plausible. Never income

retentionRate.description: A currency retention the issuer published in its withholding field; not tax, already reflected in net cash

refundNote.description: For a withholding refund: the issuer's explanation

evidenceSha256.description: SHA-256 of the matched issuer record exactly as stored; recomputable from the database

get.summary: One corporate action with its full lifecycle, distinct timestamps, every issuer revision, chain evidence, journal history and lineage

treatment.description: income: units added are income. quantity_basis: units rescaled, basis spread across them. basis_allocation: units added are principal bought with distributed value. identity: same position in a new underlying form. not_booked: recognised, not booked; conversion disabled

status.description: validated: confirmed against real recorded instances. unvalidated: no real instance has confirmed it; never booked. not_built: recognised only

steps.description: Append-only: every issuer revision and chain event, oldest first; superseded revisions are kept

inconsistency.description: Set when the stored evidence cannot form a valid lifecycle; state and steps are then empty

quantity.description: Units added (negative: removed). Zero for an ordinary split

factor.description: New units per old unit, for splits, stock dividends and identity changes

distributedFraction.description: Share of the position's value delivered by a spin-off or rights distribution: (M_new − M_old) ÷ M_new

usd.description: Income value; only for income. Null means unknown, never zero

proceedsUsd.description: Issuer proceeds for a distribution, when published and plausible. Never income

retentionRate.description: A currency retention the issuer published in its withholding field; not tax, already reflected in net cash

refundNote.description: For a withholding refund: the issuer's explanation

evidenceSha256.description: SHA-256 of the matched issuer record exactly as stored; recomputable from the database

issuerRevisions.description: Every stored revision of the issuer event, including cancelled and superseded ones

issuerRecord.description: The matched issuer record exactly as stored

kind.description: mainnet: real chain history. synthetic: generated demo data on a local network

issuerEffectiveAt.description: Effective time on the matched issuer record

issuerCreatedAt.description: When the issuer created the matched record

configuredActivationAt.description: Activation timestamp written to the mint

publicationBlockTime.description: Block time of the transaction that wrote it

firstObservedActiveAt.description: First stored mint-state observation at or after activation

ingestedAt.description: When Corpact stored the matched issuer record

history.description: Every recognition and reversal of this action, oldest first

classifierStatus.description: validated: confirmed against real recorded instances. unvalidated: no real instance has confirmed it; never booked. not_built: recognised only

cashBasisFraction.description: Share of basis that left the lineage as cash

successors.description: Basis fractions plus cashBasisFraction sum to exactly 1

lineage.description: The lineage link this action wrote, for identity changes
